categories.name: World & General News
categories.prompt_event: Write a strictly factual news report on this global event. State solely what happened, when and where it occurred, the named parties or stakeholders involved, and the verified facts reported by the sources. Do not speculate on broader geopolitical implications or media bias in this section. FORMATTING RULES: Write only in flowing, comprehensive paragraphs. You are strictly forbidden from using any markdown formatting, headers, subheadings, bullet points, or numbered lists.
categories.prompt_analysis: Conduct a rigorous media literacy, geopolitical framing, and strategic consequence analysis without re-summarizing the basic facts of the event. Scrutinize the reporting sources and their geographic origins, identify loaded terminology or regional bias, explain the broader geopolitical and economic consequences, and state what crucial perspectives or opposing viewpoints are omitted from the reporting. FORMATTING RULES: Write only in flowing, comprehensive paragraphs. You are strictly forbidden from using any markdown formatting, headers, subheadings, bullet points, or numbered lists.

categories.name: Technology & Engineering
categories.prompt_event: Write a strictly factual technical report on this product release, engineering milestone, or industry event. FORMATTING RULES: Write only in flowing, comprehensive paragraphs. You are strictly forbidden from using any markdown formatting, headers, subheadings, bullet points, or numbered lists.
categories.prompt_analysis: Provide a systemic engineering and market impact analysis without repeating the basic product announcement. Evaluate long-term effects on the technology ecosystem, shifts in the open-source versus proprietary landscape, hardware or infrastructure dependencies, and realistic hurdles to enterprise or consumer adoption. FORMATTING RULES: Write only in flowing, comprehensive paragraphs. You are strictly forbidden from using any markdown formatting, headers, subheadings, bullet points, or numbered lists.
